text: #765, built by hand. Refines D-0311. A configured TypeScript part's declared format, lint, build and test commands run with its prepared node_modules/.bin first on PATH, as npm run does, so the commands invariant init drafts (eslint, tsc, vitest run, jest, prettier) resolve to the locked tools instead of failing with "not found" in the pinned Node image. Only the declared commands get it: Invariant's own helpers, such as the dependency seal's node -e, acceptance processes and Go and Python parts keep the image's PATH, so a locked package can't stand in for node. The tools still come only from the prepared, locked dependencies; a candidate's node_modules stays removed. DependencySession.Run, which runs a part's declared commands one at a time, does the same.
